product_overview: Git Profile Search is a web app that lets users look up GitHub profiles by username and inspect key profile details. From a найден profile, users can also open a dedicated view of that user's top repositories sorted by stars.
core_goals: Search for a GitHub user by username
View key public profile information for a GitHub user
Inspect the user's top repositories sorted by star count
Open a repository on GitHub from the app and return to the previous view

features.name: GitHub User Search
features.description: Allows users to search for a GitHub username and view the user's public profile details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type a GitHub username in the search input -> Submit the search -> See a loading state -> View the user's avatar, login, location, followers, and following counts
Navigate to / -> Type a GitHub username in the search input -> Submit the search -> See an error message when the user is not found
Navigate to / -> Submit the search with an empty input -> See an input validation or invalid-search outcome

features.name: View Top Repositories
features.description: Lets users open a GitHub user's repository list and review the user's top 5 repositories by stars.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Search for a GitHub user -> View the user profile -> Open the top repositories view -> View the top 5 repositories with name, language, stars, and forks
Navigate to /repos/:username -> View the top 5 repositories with name, language, stars, and forks -> Open a repository on GitHub in a new tab
Navigate to /repos/:username -> View the top 5 repositories with name, language, stars, and forks -> Return to the previous page

known_limitations.issue: GitHub API rate limits apply without VITE_GITHUB_TOKEN
known_limitations.impact: Frequent searches may fail or return 403 under rate limit

known_limitations.impact: Searching with empty input triggers invalid API call
